g1.label: 1. What is being celebrated?
g1.why: The recording says the festival celebrates the many cultures of the neighbourhood.

g2.label: 2. When does it end Saturday?
g2.why: The recording says the festival runs until nine in the evening on Saturday.

g3.label: 3. How many countries at food stalls?
g3.why: The recording says food stalls represent over twenty different countries.

g4.label: 4. When does live music start?
g4.why: The recording says live music starts at two o'clock.

g5.label: 5. What's asked regarding cost?
g5.why: The recording says entry is free but a small donation is requested.

g6.label: 6. Why does Hanna want to live there?
g6.why: The recording says Hanna thinks living around different cultures teaches you a lot.

g7.label: 7. What do some people prefer?
g7.why: The recording says some people prefer somewhere quieter and less mixed.

g8.label: 8. When do they agree to meet?
g8.why: The recording says they agree to meet at the food stalls at two.

g1.label: 1. Felix — wants baklava
g1.why: The text says the Turkish stall serves baklava, among other things.

g2.label: 2. Greta — vegetarian, fresh food
g2.why: The text says the Vietnamese stall is famous for fresh spring rolls.

g3.label: 3. Omar — handmade gift
g3.why: The text says the Craft stall sells handmade jewellery and textiles.

g4.label: 4. Lina — practise Turkish
g4.why: The text says the Language Exchange Tent lets visitors practise speaking with volunteers.

g5.label: 5. The festival's tenth year
g5.why: The text confirms this is the tenth year the festival has run.

g6.label: 6. Food stalls only from Europe
g6.why: The text says food stalls represent cuisines from all over the world, not just Europe.

g7.label: 7. Fixed entry fee
g7.why: The text says entry is free, with donations welcome — not a fixed fee.

g8.label: 8. Children's area has a puppet show
g8.why: The text confirms the children's area includes a puppet show.
